description: Color change of red and green, hold 5 s, brightness 100. A hold change at 6.8 s holds red at factor 200 (fading to dark) and fades it down; the change back at 7.1 s comes when the effect is green, so the fade-down goes on to 40 at 7.3 s and the effect starts again with red at 1000, reached at 7.8 s.
